From 5c0861989cc197c29433915774f805299a497977 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Zhou Wang <wangzhou1@hisilicon.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Aug 2019 17:28:37 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] crypto: hisilicon - init curr_sgl_dma to fix compile warning

Just init curr_sgl_dma = 0 to avoid compile warning.

Fixes: dfed0098ab91 ("crypto: hisilicon - add hardware SGL support")
Reported-by: kbuild test robot <lkp@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Zhou Wang <wangzhou1@hisilicon.com>
Signed-off-by: Herbert Xu <herbert@gondor.apana.org.au>

diff --git a/drivers/crypto/hisilicon/sgl.c b/drivers/crypto/hisilicon/sgl.c
index 8ef7679a365e..e083d172b618 100644
--- a/drivers/crypto/hisilicon/sgl.c
+++ b/drivers/crypto/hisilicon/sgl.c
@@ -150,7 +150,7 @@ hisi_acc_sg_buf_map_to_hw_sgl(struct device *dev,
 			      u32 index, dma_addr_t *hw_sgl_dma)
 {
 	struct hisi_acc_hw_sgl *curr_hw_sgl;
-	dma_addr_t curr_sgl_dma;
+	dma_addr_t curr_sgl_dma = 0;
 	struct acc_hw_sge *curr_hw_sge;
 	struct scatterlist *sg;
 	int sg_n = sg_nents(sgl);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/crypto/hisilicon/sgl.c`**
   - The variable `curr_sgl_dma` was modified to be initialized to `0` at the point of declaration. 
   - Original line: `dma_addr_t curr_sgl_dma;`
   - Modified line: `dma_addr_t curr_sgl_dma = 0;`

### Relationships
- The modification in `sgl.c` addresses a compile warning related to the uninitialized variable `curr_sgl_dma`. By initializing it to `0`, the patch ensures that the variable has a defined value, which resolves the warning without altering the functionality of the code. This change is part of a broader effort to improve code quality and maintainability, as indicated by the reported issue from the kbuild test robot.
